Service.Name: GlobalExpressGuaranteed
Service.Hint: Global Express Guaranteed (GXG) service is an international expedited delivery service provided through an alliance with FedEx Corporation. It provides reliable, high-speed, guaranteed, and time-definite service from selected Post Office facilities in the United States to a large number of international destinations.
Service.Caption: Global Exp Grntd

Service.Name: IntExpressMailFlatRate
Service.Hint: Express Mail International is a reliable high-speed mail service available to certain countries (see Individual Country Listings for service availability). Express Mail International with Guarantee service - which offers a date-certain, postage-refund guarantee - is available only to Australia, China, Hong Kong, Japan, and Korea, Republic of (South Korea).
Service.Caption: Express Mail F/R

Service.Name: IntExpressMail

Service.Caption: Express Mail Int.

Service.Name: PriorityMailInternational
Service.Hint: With the exception of the flat-rate envelope, Priority Mail International is a parcel service. Written correspondence having the nature of current and personal correspondence is not permitted in Priority Mail International parcels, but may be sent in the Priority Mail International flat-rate envelope.
Service.Caption: Priority Mail Int.

Service.Name: FirstClassMailInternational
Service.Hint: The First-Class Mail International classification encompasses all the classes of international mail that were formerly categorized as airmail letter-post and economy letter-post, post and postal cards, printed matter, and small packets that were formerly categorized as LC (letters and cards) and AO (other articles).
Service.Caption: First Class Mail Int.

Service.Name: CertificateOfMailing
Service.Hint: Certificate of mailing service provides evidence that mail has been presented to the USPS for mailing. Certificate of mailing service does not provide a record of delivery. Available for First Class, Priority and Parcel Post.
Service.Caption: Certificate of Mailing

Service.Name: Certified
Service.Hint: Certified Mail service provides the sender with a mailing receipt that is a verification that an article was delivered or that a delivery attempt was made.
Service.Caption: Certified

Service.Name: DeliveryConfirmation
Service.Hint: Delivery Confirmation service provides the mailer with information about the date and time an article was delivered and, if delivery was attempted but not successful, the date and time of the delivery attempt. Delivery Confirmation service is available only at the time of mailing. No record is kept at the office of mailing. Delivery Confirmation service does not include insurance, but insurance may be purchased as an additional service.
Service.Caption: Delivery Confirmation

Service.Name: ExpressDomesticInsurance
Service.Hint: Express mail items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. In. Maximum insurance is $5000.00.
Service.Caption: Insurance

Service.Name: ExpressInternationalInsurance
Service.Hint: Express Mail International items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. In. Maximum insurance depends on destination.
Service.Caption: Insurance

Service.Name: GlobalExpressGuaranteedInsurance
Service.Hint: Global Express Guaranteed mail items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. Maximum insurance depends on destination.
Service.Caption: Insurance

Service.Name: Insurance
Service.Hint: Items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. Insurance under $200 does not allow a return receipt. However Delivery Confirmation is available.Insurance over $200 does allow a return receipt. Maximum insurance is $5000.00.
Service.Caption: Insurance

Service.Name: DomesticInsurance
Service.Hint: First Class, Priority and Parcel Post mail items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. Insurance under $200 does not allow a return receipt. However Delivery Confirmation is available.Insurance over $200 does allow a return receipt. Maximum insurance is $5000.00.
Service.Caption: Insurance

Service.Name: PriorityMailInternationalInsurance
Service.Hint: Priority Mail International mail items can be insured as long as they contain merchandise or items of value. In. Maximum insurance depends on destination.
Service.Caption: Insurance

Service.Name: Registered
Service.Hint: Registered Mail is the most secure service that the USPS offers. Only matter prepaid with postage at the First-Class Mail rates (including Priority Mail) may be registered. Insurance is available. See next help screen for more information.
Service.Caption: Registered

Service.Name: RestrictedDelivery
Service.Hint: Restricted delivery service permits a mailer to direct delivery only to the addressee or addressee's authorized agent. The addressee must be an individual (or natural person) specified by name.
Service.Caption: Restricted Delivery

Service.Name: ReturnReceipt
Service.Hint: Return receipt service provides a mailer with evidence of delivery (to whom the mail was delivered and date of delivery), along with information about the recipient's actual delivery address. Available at time of mailing with Express, Priority, First Class mail along with Certified mail or Insured mail over $200. Parcel post with Insured mail over $200.
Service.Caption: Return Receipt

Service.Name: SignatureConfirmation
Service.Hint: Signature Confirmation service provides the mailer with information about the date and time an article was delivered and, if delivery was attempted but not successful, the date and time of the delivery attempt. A delivery record, including the recipient's signature, is maintained by the USPS and is available, via fax or mail, upon request. No acceptance record is kept at the office of mailing. Signature Confirmation service is available only at the time of mailing. Signature Confirmation service does not include insurance, but insurance may be purchased as an additional service.
Service.Caption: Sign. Confirmation
